# WJ62 · Tài khoản Zalo · Sửa account

Group **WJ · Quản trị agent (Next.js)** · dialog · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/admin/accounts`) · account `owner`

## Purpose
Dialog or drawer of [WJ54](WJ54.md) · Tài khoản Zalo: Sửa account. Page: Zalo accounts of the bot: one card per account with its agent ("brain"), policy profile and status; the channel panel with enable switches, daily cap, send window and the emergency switch; add, edit, QR login, delete.

## Agent and care context
- The channel panel is the clinic-wide limit for proactive messages: daily cap, spacing and send window; the emergency switch (a reason is required and goes to the audit log) STOPS every proactive message of that channel (reminders, care, scheduled) until it is switched off, while replies to a patient who has just written are not blocked. A personal Zalo account carries an amber lock-risk warning.
- The default policy profile of a new account is `patient_channel`; switching it to `staff_assistant` shows a red warning because the account then sends directly, without a reviewer (WJ60).

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `owner` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `admin.accounts`; the "Kênh gửi tin" panel needs `admin.channels`, the emergency switch `admin.kill_switch`, the policy select `admin.policy`.
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager.
- Menu entry: "Tài khoản Zalo" in the section "Quản trị agent", shown when the role holds any of `admin.accounts`.

## Key actions
- (actions of the page; this state or dialog adds the controls its Layout lists)
- "Thêm account" (personal QR account, official bot token, OA not supported yet)
- Per account: switch, "Login QR" (personal only), "Sửa", "Xóa"
- Channel panel: enable, daily proactive cap, minimum and maximum gap, send window from/to, "Lưu cấu hình", "Công tắc khẩn"

## Business rules
- Patient safety is a policy profile, never a removed feature: `patient_channel` (the default: messages to patients go to the review queue and a person sends them; memory from patient content is off; image, video, document and web tools are off; a red flag goes to a doctor before any model call; personal data is masked before the model; identity of a Zalo user is confirmed before the assistant names a patient) and `staff_assistant` (internal, staff-only accounts). The profile is set per Zalo account and per agent, the stricter of the two applies (PLAN-AI01 section 5).
